description_en: Updates the shared screen layout by calling UpdateShareScreenLayout. This operation can be used in classroom scenarios to overlay the teacher's camera feed on the shared screen in a live stream
description_zh: 调用UpdateShareScreenLayout更新共享屏幕布局。可用于课堂场景，直播画面中共享屏幕画面叠加老师摄像头画面
kebab_example: aliyun imp update-share-screen-layout --app-id lq0000cu --class-id AE350000T95F --enable-overlay true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateShareScreenLayout

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the application, which consists of 6 lowercase letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 应用唯一标识，由6位小写字母、数字组成
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the classroom, returned by calling CreateClass
parameters.help_zh: 课堂唯一标识，由调用CreateClass返回
parameters.name: class_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the teacher's camera overlay
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启叠加老师画面
parameters.name: enable_overlay

parameters.help_en: The X coordinate of the overlay. The origin is the upper-left corner. The value is normalized to 1
parameters.help_zh: 叠加画面X坐标，起点为左上角，归一化为1
parameters.name: overlay_x

parameters.help_en: The Y coordinate of the overlay. The origin is the upper-left corner. The value is normalized to 1
parameters.help_zh: 叠加画面Y坐标，起点为左上角，归一化为1
parameters.name: overlay_y

parameters.help_en: The width of the overlay, normalized to 1
parameters.help_zh: 叠加画面宽度，归一化为1
parameters.name: overlay_width

parameters.help_en: The height of the overlay, normalized to 1
parameters.help_zh: 叠加画面高度，归一化为1
parameters.name: overlay_height
